title: Skinny White Chocolate Coconut Iced Coffee
description: All the decadent flavors of white chocolate and coconut in a low calorie iced coffee - perfect for a hot day when you want a skinny, refreshing drink.
ingredients: 0.75 cup coconut milk beverage (such as Silk®)
1 tablespoon sugar-free white chocolate-flavored syrup (such as Torani®)
1 tablespoon sugar-free coconut-flavored syrup (such as Torani®)
1 packet stevia sugar substitute (such as Truvia®)

steps.text: Pour coffee in ice cube tray(s); place in freezer until frozen solid, 2 to 4 hours.
Combine coffee cubes, coconut milk, white chocolate syrup, coconut syrup, and sugar substitute in a blender; blend until icy and frothy.
